workflow: Multiple worker threads concurrently mutate and inspect the same mutable sequence without synchronization.
One thread changes the sequence structure while another performs a compound update or reads an element using assumptions about that structure.
The unsynchronized operations expose an inconsistent internal representation to the reader.
The reader follows invalid element or type metadata and accesses an unmapped address, terminating the process instead of completing safely.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized access corrupts shared mutable sequence state
decision_reason: The underlying failure is materially the same as unsynchronized concurrent access to shared mutable storage causing a race and invalid observation; the sequence’s structural mutations and resulting invalid metadata access are implementation-specific details.
